6NT5.description: Full-length human STING1 apo homodimer cryo-EM (Shang et al. 2019 Nature PMID:30842659)

4KSY.description: Human STING1 R232 LBD closed-lid 2'3'-cGAMP (1SY) X-ray (Zhang et al. 2013 Mol Cell PMID:23747010)

6MXE.description: Human STING1 G230A/H232R/R293Q open-inactive Compound 18 (K5S) antagonist X-ray (Siu et al. 2019 PMID:30655953)

6MJW.description: Human cGAS catalytic domain + human-selective inhibitor G150 (JUJ) X-ray (Lama et al. 2019 PMID:31113940)

6LRC.description: Human cGAS catalytic domain + active-site inhibitor PF-06928215 (KHM) X-ray (PMID:32459092)

SN-011.mechanism: Reversible competitive STING1 CDN-pocket antagonist locking open inactive dimer (Hong et al. 2021 PMID:34099558)

H-151.mechanism: Covalent indole-urea modifier of STING1 transmembrane Cys91 blocking Golgi palmitoylation (Haag et al. 2018 PMID:29973723; TDP-43 ALS mouse rescue Yu et al. 2020 PMID:33031745)

Compound_18.mechanism: 2:1 stoichiometry reversible non-CDN human STING1 open-cleft antagonist (Siu et al. 2019 ACS Med Chem Lett PMID:30655953)

G150.mechanism: Human-selective active-site cGAS inhibitor (Lama et al. 2019 Nat Commun PMID:31113940; inactive on mouse cGAS)

PF-06928215.mechanism: Biochemical active-site cGAS inhibitor with high polar carboxylic-acid TPSA (111 A2) limiting cellular/CNS permeability

TDI-6570.mechanism: Brain-penetrant preclinical tricyclic pyrido-indole mouse-active cGAS inhibitor rescuing TDP-43 Q331K mouse splicing and motor deficits (Liu et al. 2026 bioRxiv PMID:41809005)

VENT-03.primary_endpoint: Percent change from baseline in skin interferon gene signature at Day 28

Yu_2020_Cell.finding: TDP-43 mitochondrial invasion triggers mPTP/VDAC1 mtDNA release activating cGAS-STING1; Sting1 KO or H-151 rescues TARDBP mutant mice

McCauley_2020_Nature.finding: Myeloid C9orf72 loss impairs autolysosomal STING1 degradation causing hyperactive Type I IFN response in C9-ALS/FTD blood and brain

Marques_2024_ActaNeuropathol.finding: Neuron-autonomous STING1 activation selectively in vulnerable human familial/sporadic ALS Layer V and spinal motor neurons driven by DNA damage

Liu_2026_bioRxiv_GanLab.finding: Microglial cGAS inhibition reverses neuronal pTDP-43 and RNA mis-splicing in human iPSC microglia-MN co-cultures and TDP-43 Q331K mice (TDI-6570)

Horiuchi_2026_ActaNeuropatholCommun.finding: Tbk1-/-; Tnf-/- double-KO in SOD1-G93A mice accelerates onset, slows post-onset progression via dampened microglial IFN, unchanged total survival

Sakai_2026_EMBORep.finding: Neuronal TBK1 senses aggregation-prone monomeric TDP-43 to drive IFN-beta->IFNAR->PSMB8 immunoproteasome clearance independently of macroautophagy, making direct TBK1 inhibition unsafe in ALS
